meta.title: For businesses — Know where your business stands
meta.description: With the CFDI you already issue and receive: a fixed-price diagnostic, a monthly plan, or the Individual plan to see your own company every month.

hero.title: Know where your business stands.
hero.subtitle: With the CFDI you already issue and receive: a fixed-price diagnostic or a monthly plan to see how the business is doing.

options.title: Pick the one that matches the question you have.

individual.title: Individual plan
individual.lead: For a founder who wants to see their own company every month.
individual.note: We give you a step-by-step guide to download your XML from the SAT, or you can ask your accountant for them.

diagnostic.title: Business Diagnostic
diagnostic.lead: A one-off, fixed-price analysis with a scored view, the findings that matter and an action plan.

monitoring.title: Monthly Monitoring
monitoring.lead: A dashboard and a management report every month, with a 60-minute quarterly review.

analysis.title: Five dimensions, on one scale.
analysis.intro: The same five that make up the Forcelis Business Score, so one period can be compared with the next.

accountant.title: Already have an accountant? We work with them.
accountant.body: Forcelis does not do accounting and does not file returns. If your accountant uses Forcelis, you receive your reports through them.

closing.title: Start with your own numbers.
closing.body: A diagnostic answers the question once. The monthly plan keeps answering it.
